sources.title: Introducing Mistral 3
sources.evidence: December 2, 2025 launch releases dense Ministral 3 models in three sizes, each with Base, Instruct and Reasoning variants, image understanding and Apache 2.0 licensing. This is distinct from the October 2024 Ministral generation.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B v25.12 — exact model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Exact ministral-8b-2512 API identifier and December 2 release. The delivered React payload separately links the Instruct checkpoint and reports Parameters (B)=8 and Active (B)=8 in its row; these are nominal size-class values. Lists Apache 2.0, 256k context and function calling.

sources.title: Mistral API changelog
sources.evidence: The December 2, 2025 entry explicitly announces ministral-8b-2512 alongside the other Ministral 3 API sizes, verifying the dated identifier and release chronology.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B — official Markdown reference
sources.evidence: Enumerates API names ministral-8b-2512 and ministral-8b-latest; text/image input, text output, function calling and 256k context. Links Instruct, Reasoning and Base checkpoints separately.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact dated model identity
sources.evidence: Fresh exact record mistralai/ministral-8b-2512 explicitly sets hugging_face_id to mistralai/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512. Used only to bridge the provider/catalog identity to the exact checkpoint; technical counts and architecture are verified from primary evidence.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512 — pinned model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the FP8 instruction-post-trained checkpoint, Apache 2.0, native vision and function calling. Reports rounded 8.4B language and 0.4B vision components. Serving notes explicitly give maximum model length 262144. Distinguishes this checkpoint from Base and Reasoning siblings.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B Instruct — pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Dense 34-layer ministral3 decoder, width 4096, FFN 14336, 32 query/8 KV heads, vocabulary 131072, untied embeddings and 262144 positions. Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration includes a 24-layer Pixtral vision encoder/projector; FP8 excludes vision, projector and output head.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B Instruct — pinned native configuration
sources.evidence: Independently confirms dense decoder dimensions, untied embeddings, FP8 format, 262144 positions with YaRN factor 16 from 16384, plus a 24-layer image encoder and patch-merge projector.

sources.title: Ministral 3 — technical report
sources.evidence: The Mistral-authored report describes dense decoder-only Transformers with GQA, SwiGLU, RMSNorm and YaRN. Table 1 gives the 8B dimensions matching the checkpoint. Separates Instruct and Reasoning post-training; frozen learned vision weights and a trained projector remain model components.

sources.title: Mistral maintainer clarification of non-reasoning status
sources.evidence: Read via public Hugging Face discussion API after the web renderer failed. Mistral organization member juliendenize explicitly calls this exact Instruct checkpoint non-reasoning. June 30, 2026 merged tokenizer-only correction removes unused THINK tokens; commit 5b4be2ca71f1b1c2f9af5bfbc6192ff4f3e2e760.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh public ungated repository at revision 5b26027e7b19eeb4b7352e1fed3926375dd2cb4d. Contains native weights and three Transformers safetensors shards. Pinned card, configuration, native parameters, template and tensor index were retrieved. No separate LICENSE file is listed; Apache 2.0 is explicit in card and developer documentation.

sources.title: Pinned complete Transformers tensor index
sources.evidence: All 1007 entries across exactly three shards were matched to freshly retrieved bounded headers. They comprise 531 learned-weight tensors and 476 scalar activation/weight scales. Both untied token embeddings and the output head are present.

sources.title: Pinned checkpoint shard 1 of 3 — complete bounded header
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated HTTP 206 ranges retrieved the eight-byte length and 40080-byte JSON header only, for a 4983094790-byte shard. Every BF16/unpacked F8_E4M3 tensor shape matches its byte extent; contiguous offsets cover the complete file. Across all three headers: 8,918,026,240 learned scalars, excluding 476 scalar quantization scales; no weight payload downloaded.

sources.title: Ministral 3 8B Instruct — pinned chat template
sources.evidence: Native template serializes tool definitions, calls and tool results; supports text and image/image_url content. Inspected as model evidence, not executed. Complements exact model docs and card for modalities and tool support.

name.note: Retain the dated display name: developer product name plus fixed 2512 revision. The API identifier is ministral-8b-2512.

developer.note: Official announcement and mistralai checkpoint establish authorship; retain normalized catalog label.

family.note: The exact model belongs to the December 2025 Ministral 3 line, distinct from original Ministral 8B released in 2024.

release_date.note: Dated public launch, exact API changelog and model reference agree; later technical-report publication is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Official public ungated checkpoint; unauthenticated bounded retrieval succeeded for all three weight shards.

license.note: Named model license is explicit in the launch, exact card and Instruct Weights row; normalize spelling.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint count derived from all 531 learned .weight tensors: 8,918,026,240 logical scalars, including language, vision and projector. Excludes 476 scalar FP8 scales. Untied embeddings and output head are both counted; no packed tensors or additional buffers occur. This is more precise than the developer nominal 8B size class.

active_parameters_b.note: Official exact Instruct row explicitly labels Active (B)=8. Retain as nominal disclosure, not an exact per-token count or an assumption equating dense total and active parameters. Its difference from the complete checkpoint total does not establish expert sparsity.

architecture.note: Dense Transformer language decoder with grouped-query attention, Pixtral vision encoder and projector. Configurations, technical-report row and complete tensor structure agree; no MoE routers are present.

context_window.note: Both pinned configurations and the Instruct serving notes specify 262144. Separate Reasoning-variant or hosting-specific limits are not substituted; no live authenticated endpoint invocation was performed.

modalities.note: Exact API documentation and checkpoint establish native text/image input with text generation. The image encoder is present; no native audio or image generation is claimed.

reasoning.note: Exact provider identity links this dated record to Instruct, whose Mistral maintainer explicitly states non-reasoning. Sibling Reasoning benchmark rows and previously unused thinking tokens are not transferred.

tool_call.note: Native function calling is explicit in exact documentation/card and implemented in the checkpoint serialization template.

description.value: Instruction-tuned text and image model for local and edge deployment, with native function calling.
description.note: Replace unmeasured latency and cost claims with documented instruction, modalities, deployment and tool capabilities.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned text and image model for local and edge deployment, with native function calling.
patch.notes: The dated ministral-8b-2512 API entry maps to Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512. The complete released checkpoint contains 8,918,026,240 learned parameters: 8,489,553,920 language, 403,305,472 vision and 25,166,848 projector parameters, excluding 476 scalar FP8 scales. Mistral’s 8B total/active labels are nominal size classes; the active value is retained as published and is not an exact per-token count or evidence of MoE sparsity. The card separately gives rounded 8.4B language and 0.4B vision components. This Instruct model is explicitly non-reasoning, supports 262,144 positions and native text/image input with tools; it is distinct from the original 2024 Ministral 8B.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the dated Ministral 8B API record and independently established its exact December 2025 Instruct checkpoint identity. Replaced nominal total 8B with complete verified 8.91802624B learned parameters from all three bounded headers, excluding FP8 scales. Added explicitly disclosed nominal active 8B, dense architecture, Apache-2.0 and primary provenance. Confirmed release, public weights, 262144 context, native vision/tools and explicit non-reasoning status. Exact components are proposed for parent review; no shared files or commits changed.
